{#- Local override of the built-in partial (upstream: zensical/templates/ partials/alternate.html, 0.0.55): the language switcher must link the SAME PAGE in the other language, not the language root. project.extra.alternate (zensical.toml / zensical-de.toml) holds the two language ROOTS as served by deploy/docs.nix ("/" EN, "/de/" DE) -- static config cannot express per-page targets. This override appends the page's root-relative page.url (trailing slash, e.g. "components/postgresql/") to the configured root; the formula works for both builds because src/ and src-de/ are 1:1 mirrors (derive_src_de.py copytree + overlay) and the /de/ prefix comes from the deployment alias, not the build. The url filter runs on alt.link only -- never on page.url, which is already a final URL. Contexts without a page object and the homepage link the bare roots. Everything else is a byte-identical upstream copy (whitespace-preserving {%- set chain: renders the same markup as upstream for the roots case); pinned by tests/test_alternate_links.py, including a byte-for-byte upstream comparison. The head tags (base.html) intentionally still point at the language roots -- known SEO limitation, see zensical.toml. -#}
{% set icon = config.theme.icon.alternate or "material/translate" %}
    {% for alt in config.extra.alternate %} {%- set href = alt.link | url %} {%- if page and not page.is_homepage %} {%- set href = href ~ page.url %} {%- endif %}
  • {{ alt.name }}
    • {% endfor %}
